verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe a multi-user mode with dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage giving data isolation and access control across users/organizations, which is a real but narrow tenancy mechanism (cognee-docs-9, cognee-docs-25, cognee-docs-48). However there is no evidence of role definitions, policy configuration, ACL granularity beyond dataset scoping, or any audit/logging of access events. Missing for 10: explicit role-based access control, fine-grained ACLs beyond dataset scope, and audit trail/logging of who read or wrote memory.
